away.summary: The Blue Jackets (7-7-0) are projected to start Jet Greaves in net after Cam Talbot made 27 saves in a 2-1 shootout win against the Dallas Stars on Thursday. Erik Gudbranson, Jack Williams, and Steven Lorentz are scratched, while Isac Lundestrom is out with a lower-body injury. Williams and Lorentz were recalled from Cleveland but are unlikely to play.

home.summary: The Sabres (7-5-3) are projected to start Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen, with Colten Ellis listed as the backup. Conor Timmins will make his season debut after recovering from a lower-body injury sustained in the preseason finale, replacing Louis Crevier in the lineup. Jiri Kulich returns after missing five games due to a concussion, taking Ryan McLeod's spot.
